title: Longest Common Subsequence
statement:
Find how long the longest common subsequence of two words is. A subsequence keeps some of a word's letters in their order and drops the rest, so `ace` is a subsequence of `abcde`, but `aec` is not.

The first line is the first word and the second line is the second word, each made of 1 to 1000 lowercase letters. Print the length of the longest string that is a subsequence of both words. When they share no letter at all, the only common subsequence is the empty one, so print `0`.

In the example, `ace` is the longest common subsequence.

Input:

```text
abcde
ace
```

Expected output:

```text
3
```
